decisions.reason: As a laser-marking workstation that builds directly on the firm's established capabilities and remained on the website across two years, it is likely to be retained as a niche but complementary part of the portfolio.
This thermal inkjet printer is close to the core coding business, has sustained standalone presentation, and fits the firm's strong in-house R&D and application-integration capabilities.
The piezo inkjet printer also sits close to existing knowledge and customer needs, and the firm's absorptive capacity should let it refine and commercialize it rather than withdraw it quickly.
Industrial laser marking systems are central to the firm's established offer and Industry 4.0 direction, so a recent home-page launch strongly signals continued commitment.
The compact laser marking cabin is a newly launched extension of the firm's proven laser portfolio, making it highly likely the firm will keep developing and selling it.
Although more specialized, the lubricant printing system leverages adjacent printing know-how and its trade-fair award suggests enough early validation for the firm to keep it on the market.
